thresholds: Nominal numerical cross-check:1cm position and1e-5m/s velocity; not a flight accuracy or rigorous integration-error enclosure
limitations: Frozen commanded controls are replayed,not independently optimized
Both SciPy and Hipparchus use DOP853; force,recoil and rocket bookkeeping are separate implementations
Sensitivity inputs are deterministic assumptions,not measured dispersions or reliability
No finite burn,slew,closed-loop navigation,contact,body geometry,source rating or environmental qualification
